(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method, comprising: inputting database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm, wherein the database constructs include one or more distinct representations of query execution plans; obtaining a database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct, wherein the modified database construct includes a revised representation of the query execution plans; and processing a database operation with the database constructs and the modified database construct.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The method of claim 1 further comprising, storing the database operation predictor in database statistics associated with the database operation and the database constructs, wherein the database statistics maintain historical performance data relating to prior executions of the database operation.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer, including a least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query based on the least cost query execution plan; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time, wherein the modification is made to improve adherence to a predetermined performance threshold. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 12, wherein modifying further includes changing an execution resource of the least cost query execution plan based on the predicted query execution time and a current performance associated with the execution resource, and wherein the execution resource is selected from a group consisting of processor allocation, memory allocation, and I/O bandwidth. 

(Original) Claim 15: The method of claim 12, wherein providing further includes providing the database tool within a workload scheduler and management component of a database system. 

(Original) Claim 16: The method of claim 12, wherein training further includes training the machine-learning algorithm as a linear regression-based machine-learning algorithm. 

(Original) Claim 20: The system of claim 19, wherein the predicted value is an estimated query execution time for a query and the database operation is execution of a query execution plan for the query within the database management system.
